text.cop: ⲉϥⲉ̀ⲓ̀ ⲉ̀ϩ̀ⲣⲏⲓ ⲉ̀ϫⲉⲛ ⲡⲁⲓⲗⲁⲟⲥ ⲁ̀ϫⲟⲥ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ:
text.cop_lat: efe-i e-ehree ejen pailaos agos teerou:
text.en: be upon all this congregation.
Say all of You, Amen so be it.

text.cop: Ⲫⲏⲉ̀ⲧⲉ ⲟⲩⲟⲛ ⲙⲁϣϫ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟϥ ⲉ̀ⲥⲱⲧⲉⲙ ⲙⲁⲣⲉϥⲥⲱⲧⲉⲙ:
text.cop_lat: Fee-ete o-on mashg emmof esotem marefsotem:
text.en: He who has an ear, let him hear,

section.en: "He who have an ear..." - Ch 2, 3, Ⲫⲏⲉ̀ⲧⲉ ⲟⲩⲟⲛ
section.path: Fasts › Holy Pascha Week › Bright Saturday › The Book of the Revelation of St. John the Beloved

text.cop: ϫⲉ ⲟⲩ ⲡⲉ ⲉ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡⲓⲡ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁ ϫⲱ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟϥ ⲛ̀ⲛⲓⲉⲕⲕ̀ⲗⲏⲥⲓⲁ̀.
text.cop_lat: je ou pe ete pi-epnevma go emmof enniekekleesi-a.
text.en: what the Spirit says, to the Churches.

text.cop: 7:1 Ⲙⲉⲛⲉⲛⲥⲁ ⲛⲁⲓ ⲇⲉ ⲁⲓⲛⲁⲩ ⲉ̀ϥ̀ⲧⲟⲟⲩ (ⲉ̀ⲇ̅) ⲛ̀ⲁⲅⲅⲉⲗⲟⲥ ⲉⲩⲟ̀ϩⲓ ⲉ̀ⲣⲁⲧⲟⲩ:
text.cop_lat: 7:1 Menensa nai the ainav e-eftoou (psit) enangelos evohi eratou:
text.en: 7:1 After these things I saw four angels standing at the four corners of the earth,

section.en: Chapter 7, Ⲕⲉⲫⲁⲗⲉⲟⲛ Ⲍ̅
section.path: Fasts › Holy Pascha Week › Bright Saturday › The Book of the Revelation of St. John the Beloved

text.en: holding the four winds of the earth,

text.cop: ⲉⲩⲁ̀ⲙⲟⲛⲓ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓϥ̀ⲧⲟⲟⲩ ⲑⲏⲛⲟⲩ ϩⲓⲛⲁ ⲛ̀ⲧⲟⲩϣ̀ⲧⲉⲙⲛⲓϥⲓ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲛⲓⲑⲏⲟⲩ ϩⲓϫⲉⲛ ⲡ̀ⲕⲁϩⲓ ⲟⲩⲇⲉ ϩⲓϫⲉⲛ ⲫ̀ⲓⲟⲙ ⲟⲩⲇⲉ ϩⲓϫⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲓⲁⲣⲱⲟⲩ ⲟⲩⲇⲉ ϩⲓϫⲉⲛ ⲛⲓϣ̀ϣⲏⲛ.
text.cop_lat: evamoni empi-eftoou theenou hina entou-eshtemnifi enje nitheeou hijen epkahi outhe hijen efiom outhe hijen niaroou outhe hijen ni-eshsheen.
text.en: that the wind should not blow on the earth, on the sea, or on any tree.
text.ar: مُمْسِكِينَ أَرْبَعَ رِيَاحِ الأَرْضِ لِكَيْ لاَ تَهُبَّ رِيحٌ عَلَى الأَرْضِ وَلاَ عَلَى الْبَحْرِ وَلاَ عَلَى شَجَرَةٍ مَا.

text.cop: 7:2 Ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁⲓϫⲟⲩϣⲧ ⲁⲓⲛⲁⲩ ⲉ̀ⲕⲉⲁⲅⲅⲉⲗⲟⲥ ⲉ̀ⲁϥⲓ̀ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲙⲁ ⲛ̀ϣⲁⲓ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲫ̀ⲣⲏ ⲉ̀ⲟⲩⲟⲛ ⲟⲩⲥ̀ⲫ̀ⲣⲁⲅⲓⲥ ⲛ̀ⲧⲟⲧϥ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲫ̀ϯ ⲉⲧⲟⲛϧ:
text.cop_lat: 7:2 O-woh aigousht ainav ekeangelos eafi evol khen nima enshai ente efree eowon ou-esefragis entotf ente Efnoti etonkh:
text.en: 7:2 Then I saw another angel ascending from the east, having the seal of the living God.
text.ar: 2 وَرَأَيْتُ مَلاَكاً آخَرَ طَالِعاً مِنْ مَشْرِقِ الشَّمْسِ مَعَهُ خَتْمُ اللهِ الْحَيِّ،

text.en: And he cried with a loud voice to the four angels to whom it was granted to harm the earth and the sea,
text.ar: فَنَادَى بِصَوْتٍ عَظِيمٍ إِلَى الْمَلاَئِكَةِ الأَرْبَعَةِ الَّذِينَ أُعْطُوا أَنْ يَضُرُّوا الأَرْضَ وَالْبَحْرَ

text.en: 7:3 saying,

text.cop: ϫⲉ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉⲣⲉⲣⲁⲇⲓⲕⲓⲛ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲕⲁϩⲓ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲫ̀ⲓⲟⲙ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲓϣ̀ϣⲏⲛ ϣⲁⲧⲉⲧⲉⲛⲧⲉⲃ ⲛⲓⲉ̀ⲃⲓⲁⲓⲕ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲫ̀ϯ ⲉ̀ⲧⲟⲩⲧⲉϩⲛⲓ.
text.cop_lat: je empererathikin empikahi nem efiom nem ni-eshsheen shatetenteb ni-eviaik ente Efnoti etoutehni.
text.en: "Do not harm the earth, the sea, or the trees till we have sealed the servants of our God on their foreheads."
text.ar: «لاَ تَضُرُّوا الأَرْضَ وَلاَ الْبَحْرَ وَلاَ الأَشْجَارَ، حَتَّى نَخْتِمَ عَبِيدَ إِلَهِنَا عَلَى جِبَاهِهِمْ».

text.en: 7:4 And I heard the number of those who were sealed. One hundred and forty-four thousand of all the tribes of the children of Israel were sealed:
text.ar: 4 وَسَمِعْتُ عَدَدَ الْمَخْتُومِينَ مِئَةً وَأَرْبَعَةً وَأَرْبَعِينَ أَلْفاً، مَخْتُومِينَ مِنْ كُلِّ سِبْطٍ مِنْ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ.

text.en: 7:5 of the tribe of Judah twelve thousand were sealed;
text.ar: 5 مِنْ سِبْطِ يَهُوذَا اثْنَا عَشَرَ أَلْفَ مَخْتُومٍ.

text.cop: ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲧ̀ⲫⲩⲗⲏ ⲛ̀Ⲣⲟⲩⲃⲏⲛ ⲙⲏⲧⲥ̀ⲛⲁⲩ ⲛ̀ϣⲟ:
text.cop_lat: evol khen etfilee enrouveen meetesnav ensho:
text.en: of the tribe of Reuben twelve thousand were sealed;
text.ar: مِنْ سِبْطِ رَأُوبِينَ اثْنَا عَشَرَ أَلْفَ مَخْتُومٍ.

text.cop: ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲧ̀ⲫⲩⲗⲏ ⲛ̀Ⲅⲁⲇ ⲙⲏⲧⲥ̀ⲛⲁⲩ ⲛ̀ϣⲟ:
text.cop_lat: evol khen etfilee enghath meetesnav ensho:
text.en: of the tribe of Gad twelve thousand were sealed;
text.ar: مِنْ سِبْطِ جَادَ اثْنَا عَشَرَ أَلْفَ مَخْتُومٍ.

text.cop: 7:6 Ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲧ̀ⲫⲩⲗⲏ ⲛ̀Ⲁⲥⲥⲏⲣ ⲙⲏⲧⲥ̀ⲛⲁⲩ ⲛ̀ϣⲟ:
text.cop_lat: 7:6 Evol khen etfilee enasseer meetesnav ensho:
text.en: 7:6 of the tribe of Asher twelve thousand were sealed;
text.ar: 6 مِنْ سِبْطِ أَشِيرَ اثْنَا عَشَرَ أَلْفَ مَخْتُومٍ.

text.cop: ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲧ̀ⲫⲩⲗⲏ ⲛ̀Ⲉⲫⲑⲁⲗⲓⲙ ⲙⲏⲧⲥ̀ⲛⲁⲩ ⲛ̀ϣⲟ:
text.cop_lat: evol khen etfilee enefthalim meetesnav ensho:
text.en: of the tribe of Naphtali twelve thousand were sealed;
text.ar: مِنْ سِبْطِ نَفْتَالِي اثْنَا عَشَرَ أَلْفَ مَخْتُومٍ.

text.cop: ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲧ̀ⲫⲩⲗⲏ ⲛ̀Ⲙⲁⲛⲁⲥⲏ ⲙⲏⲧⲥ̀ⲛⲁⲩ ⲛ̀ϣⲟ:
text.cop_lat: evol khen etfilee enmanasee meetesnav ensho:
text.en: of the tribe of Manasseh twelve thousand were sealed;
text.ar: مِنْ سِبْطِ مَنَسَّى اثْنَا عَشَرَ أَلْفَ مَخْتُومٍ.

text.cop: 7:7 Ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲧ̀ⲫⲩⲗⲏ ⲛ̀Ⲥⲩⲙⲉⲱⲛ ⲙⲏⲧⲥ̀ⲛⲁⲩ ⲛ̀ϣⲟ:
text.cop_lat: 7:7 Evol khen etfilee ensimeon meetesnav ensho:
text.en: 7:7 of the tribe of Simeon twelve thousand were sealed;
text.ar: 7 مِنْ سِبْطِ شَمْعُونَ اثْنَا عَشَرَ أَلْفَ مَخْتُومٍ.

text.cop: ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲧ̀ⲫⲩⲗⲏ ⲛ̀Ⲗⲉⲩⲓ ⲙⲏⲧⲥ̀ⲛⲁⲩ ⲛ̀ϣⲟ:
text.cop_lat: evol khen etfilee enlevi meetesnav ensho:
text.en: of the tribe of Levi twelve thousand were sealed;
text.ar: مِنْ سِبْطِ لاَوِي اثْنَا عَشَرَ أَلْفَ مَخْتُومٍ.

text.cop: ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲧ̀ⲫⲩⲗⲏ ⲛ̀Ⲓⲥⲁⲭⲁⲣ ⲙⲏⲧⲥ̀ⲛⲁⲩ ⲛ̀ϣⲟ:
text.cop_lat: evol khen etfilee enisakhar meetesnav ensho:
text.en: of the tribe of Issachar twelve thousand were sealed;
text.ar: مِنْ سِبْطِ يَسَّاكَرَ اثْنَا عَشَرَ أَلْفَ مَخْتُومٍ.

text.cop: 7:8 Ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲧ̀ⲫⲩⲗⲏ ⲛ̀Ⲍⲁⲃⲟⲩⲗⲱⲛ ⲙⲏⲧⲥ̀ⲛⲁⲩ ⲛ̀ϣⲟ:
text.cop_lat: 7:8 Evol khen etfilee enzavoulon meetesnav ensho:
text.en: 7:8 of the tribe of Zebulun twelve thousand were sealed;
text.ar: 8 مِنْ سِبْطِ زَبُولُونَ اثْنَا عَشَرَ أَلْفَ مَخْتُومٍ.

text.cop: ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲧ̀ⲫⲩⲗⲏ ⲛ̀Ⲓⲱⲥⲏⲫ ⲙⲏⲧⲥ̀ⲛⲁⲩ ⲛ̀ϣⲟ:
text.cop_lat: evol khen etfilee enyoseef meetesnav ensho:
text.en: of the tribe of Joseph twelve thousand were sealed;
text.ar: مِنْ سِبْطِ يُوسُفَ اثْنَا عَشَرَ أَلْفَ مَخْتُومٍ.

text.cop: ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲧ̀ⲫⲩⲗⲏ ⲙ̀Ⲃⲉⲛⲓⲁⲙⲓⲛ ⲙⲏⲧⲥ̀ⲛⲁⲩ ⲛ̀ϣⲟ ⲉⲧⲁⲩⲉⲣⲥ̀ⲫ̀ⲣⲁⲅⲓⲍⲓⲛ ⲙ̀ⲙⲱⲟⲩ.
text.cop_lat: evol khen etfilee embeniamin meetesnav ensho etaveresefragizin emmoou.
text.en: of the tribe of Benjamin twelve thousand were sealed.
text.ar: مِنْ سِبْطِ بِنْيَامِينَ اثْنَا عَشَرَ أَلْفَ مَخْتُومٍ.

text.cop: 7:9 Ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲙⲉⲛⲉⲛⲥⲁ ⲛⲁⲓ ⲁⲓⲛⲁⲩ ⲉ̀ⲟⲩⲛⲓϣϯ ⲙ̀ⲙⲏϣ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲛ ϣ̀ϫⲟⲙ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ϩ̀ⲗⲓ ϭⲓⲏⲡⲓ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟϥ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ϣ̀ⲗⲟⲗ ⲛⲓⲃⲉⲛ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲫⲩⲗⲏ ⲛⲓⲃⲉⲛ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲗⲁⲟⲥ ⲛⲓⲃⲉⲛ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲗⲁⲥ ⲛⲓⲃⲉⲛ ⲉⲩⲟ̀ϩⲓ ⲉ̀ⲣⲁⲧⲟⲩ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉⲙ̀ⲑⲟ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲑ̀ⲣⲟⲛⲟⲥ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲉⲙ̀ⲑⲟ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓϨⲓⲏⲃ ⲉⲩϫⲏⲗ ⲛ̀ϩⲁⲛⲥ̀ⲧⲟⲗⲏ ⲛ̀ⲟⲩⲱⲃϣ ⲉ̀ⲣⲉ ⲟⲩⲟⲛ ϩⲁⲛⲟⲩⲱⲓⲛⲓ ⲛ̀ϧ̀ⲣⲏⲓ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲟⲩϫⲓϫ:
text.cop_lat: 7:9 O-woh menensa nai ainav eounishti emmeesh emmon eshgom ente ehli chieepi emmof evol khen eshlol niven nem filee niven nem laos niven nem las niven evohi eratou empe-emtho empi-ethronos nem pe-emtho empihieeb evjeel enhanestolee enowovsh ere o-on hanowoini enekhree khen noujig:
text.en: 7:9 After these things I looked, and behold, a great multitude which no one could number, of all nations, tribes, peoples, and tongues, standing before the throne and before the Lamb, clothed with white robes, with palm branches in their hands,
text.ar: 9 بَعْدَ هَذَا نَظَرْتُ وَإِذَا جَمْعٌ كَثِيرٌ لَمْ يَسْتَطِعْ أَحَدٌ أَنْ يَعُدَّهُ، مِنْ كُلِّ الأُمَمِ وَالْقَبَائِلِ وَالشُّعُوبِ وَالأَلْسِنَةِ، وَاقِفُونَ أَمَامَ الْعَرْشِ وَأَمَامَ الْحَمَلِ، مُتَسَرْبِلِينَ بِثِيَابٍ بِيضٍ وَفِي أَيْدِيهِمْ سَعَفُ النَّخْلِ

text.cop: 7:10 Ⲉⲩⲱϣ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩⲛⲓϣϯ ⲛ̀ⲥ̀ⲙⲏ ⲉⲩϫⲱ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲥ:
text.cop_lat: 7:10 Evosh evol khen ounishti enesmee evgo emmos:
text.en: 7:10 and crying out with a loud voice, saying,

text.cop: ϫⲉ ⲡⲓⲟⲩϫⲁⲓ ⲫⲁ ⲡⲉⲛⲚⲟⲩϯ ⲡⲉ ⲫⲏ ⲉⲧϩⲉⲙⲥⲓ ϩⲓϫⲉⲛ ⲡⲓⲑ̀ⲣⲟⲛⲟⲥ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲓϨⲓⲏⲃ.
text.cop_lat: je piougai fa pennoti pe fee ethemsi hijen pi-ethronos nem pihieeb.
text.en: "Salvation belongs to our God who sits on the throne, and to the Lamb!"

text.cop: 7:11 Ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛⲓⲁⲅⲅⲉⲗⲟⲥ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ ⲛⲁⲩⲟ̀ϩⲓ ⲉ̀ⲣⲁⲧⲟⲩ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉⲙ̀ⲑⲟ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲑ̀ⲣⲟⲛⲟⲥ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲓⲡ̀ⲣⲉⲥⲃⲩⲧⲉⲣⲟⲥ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲓϥ̀ⲧⲟⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ⲍⲱⲟⲛ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁⲩϩⲓⲧⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲡⲉⲥⲏⲧ ϩⲓϫⲉⲛ ⲡ̀ⲟⲩϩⲟ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉⲙ̀ⲑⲟ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲑ̀ⲣⲟⲛⲟⲥ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁⲩⲟⲩⲱϣⲧ ⲙ̀Ⲫ̀ϯ:
text.cop_lat: 7:11 O-woh niangelos teerou navohi eratou empe-emtho empi-ethronos nem ni-epresviteros nem pi-eftoou enzo-on o-woh avhitou epeseet hijen epouho empe-emtho empi-ethronos o-woh avowosht emefnoti:
text.en: 7:11 All the angels stood around the throne and the elders and the four living creatures, and fell on their faces before the throne and worshiped God,
text.ar: 11 وَجَمِيعُ الْمَلاَئِكَةِ كَانُوا وَاقِفِينَ حَوْلَ الْعَرْشِ وَالشُّيُوخِ وَالْحَيَوَانَاتِ الأَرْبَعَةِ، وَخَرُّوا أَمَامَ الْعَرْشِ عَلَى وُجُوهِهِمْ وَسَجَدُوا لِلَّهِ

text.en: 7:12 saying:
"Amen!

text.cop: ⲡⲓⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲓⲱ̀ⲟⲩ ⲛⲉⲙ ϯⲥⲟⲫⲓⲁ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲓϣⲉⲡϩ̀ⲙⲟⲧ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲓⲧⲁⲓⲟ ⲛⲉⲙ ϯϫⲟⲙ ⲛⲁ ⲡⲉⲛⲚⲟⲩϯ ⲛⲉ ϣⲁ ⲉ̀ⲛⲉϩ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡⲓⲉ̀ⲛⲉϩ:
text.cop_lat: pi-esmou nem pi-oou nem tisofia nem pishepehmot nem pitaio nem tigom na pennoti ne sha eneh ente pi-eneh:
text.en: Blessing and glory and wisdom, Thanksgiving and honor and power and might, Be to our God forever and ever.
text.ar: الْبَرَكَةُ وَالْمَجْدُ وَالْحِكْمَةُ وَالشُّكْرُ وَالْكَرَامَةُ وَالْقُدْرَةُ وَالْقُوَّةُ لإِلَهِنَا إِلَى أَبَدِ الآبِدِينَ.

text.en: Amen."

text.cop: 7:13 Ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁϥⲉⲣⲟⲩⲱ̀ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲟⲩⲁⲓ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲡ̀ⲣⲉⲥⲃⲩⲧⲉⲣⲟⲥ ⲡⲉϫⲁϥ ⲛⲏⲓ:
text.cop_lat: 7:13 O-woh aferowo enje o-wai evol khen ni-epresviteros pegaf nee:
text.en: 7:13 Then one of the elders answered, saying to me,

text.cop: ϫⲉ ⲛⲓⲙ ⲛⲉ ⲛⲁⲓ ⲉ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲁⲓϩ̀ⲃⲱⲥ ⲛ̀ⲟⲩⲱⲃϣ ⲧⲟⲓ ϩⲓⲱⲧⲟⲩ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲉⲧⲁⲩⲓ̀ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲑⲱⲛ.
text.cop_lat: je nim ne nai ete nai-ehvos enowovsh toi hiotou o-woh etavi evol thon.
text.en: "Who are these arrayed in white robes, and where did they come from?"
text.ar: «هَؤُلاَءِ الْمُتَسَرْبِلُونَ بِالثِّيَابِ الْبِيضِ، مَنْ هُمْ وَمِنْ أَيْنَ أَتُوا؟»

text.en: 7:14 And I said to him,
"Sir,
you know." So he said to me,

text.cop: ϫⲉ ⲛⲁⲓ ⲛⲉ ⲛⲏ ⲉⲑⲛⲏⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲛⲓϣϯ ⲛ̀ϩⲟϫϩⲉϫ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁⲩⲣⲱϧⲓ ⲛ̀ⲛⲟⲩⲥ̀ⲧⲟⲗⲏ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁⲩⲫⲉⲣⲓⲱⲟⲩ ϧⲉⲛ ⲡⲓⲥ̀ⲛⲟϥ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡⲓϨⲓⲏⲃ.
text.cop_lat: je nai ne nee ethneeou evol khen ninishti enhogheg o-woh avrokhi ennou-estolee o-woh avferioou khen pi-esnof ente pihieeb.
text.en: "These are the ones who come out of the great tribulation, and washed their robes and made them white in the blood of the Lamb.
text.ar: «هَؤُلاَءِ هُمُ الَّذِينَ أَتُوا مِنَ الضِّيقَةِ الْعَظِيمَةِ، وَقَدْ غَسَّلُوا ثِيَابَهُمْ وَبَيَّضُوهَا فِي دَمِ الْحَمَلِ.

text.cop: 7:15 Ⲉⲑⲃⲉ ⲫⲁⲓ ⲥⲉⲭⲏ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉⲙ̀ⲑⲟ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲑ̀ⲣⲟⲛⲟⲥ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲫ̀ϯ:
text.cop_lat: 7:15 Ethve fai sekee empe-emtho empi-ethronos ente Efnoti:
text.en: 7:15 Therefore they are before the throne of God,
text.ar: 15 مِنْ أَجْلِ ذَلِكَ هُمْ أَمَامَ عَرْشِ اللهِ

text.cop: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲥⲉϣⲉⲙϣⲓ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟϥ ϧⲉⲛ ⲡⲉϥⲉⲣⲫⲉⲓ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲉ̀ϩⲟⲟⲩ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲓⲉ̀ϫⲱⲣϩ:
text.cop_lat: o-woh seshemshi emmof khen peferfei empi-ehoou nem pi-egorh:
text.en: and serve Him day and night in His temple.

text.cop: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲫⲏ ⲉⲧϩⲉⲙⲥⲓ ϩⲓϫⲉⲛ ⲡⲓⲑ̀ⲣⲟⲛⲟⲥ ⲉϥⲉ̀ⲉⲣϧⲏⲓⲃⲓ ⲉ̀ϫⲱⲟⲩ.
text.cop_lat: o-woh fee ethemsi hijen pi-ethronos efe-erkheeivi egoou.
text.en: And He who sits on the throne will dwell among them.

text.cop: 7:16 Ⲛ̀ⲛⲟⲩϩ̀ⲕⲟ ⲟⲩⲇⲉ ⲛ̀ⲛⲟⲩⲓⲃⲓ ϫⲉ ⲟⲩⲇⲉ ⲛ̀ⲛⲟⲩϧⲓⲥⲓ ⲟⲩⲇⲉ ⲛ̀ⲛⲉ ϧⲏⲓⲃⲓ ⲓ̀ ⲉ̀ϫⲱⲟⲩ ⲟⲩⲇⲉ ⲕⲁⲩⲥⲱⲛ ⲛⲓⲃⲉⲛ:
text.cop_lat: 7:16 Ennou-ehko outhe ennouivi je outhe ennoukhisi outhe enne kheeivi i egoou outhe kavson niven:
text.en: 7:16 They shall neither hunger anymore nor thirst anymore; the sun shall not strike them, nor any heat;
text.ar: 16 لَنْ يَجُوعُوا بَعْدُ وَلَنْ يَعْطَشُوا بَعْدُ وَلاَ تَقَعُ عَلَيْهِمِ الشَّمْسُ وَلاَ شَيْءٌ مِنَ الْحَرِّ،

text.cop: 7:17 Ϫⲉ ⲡⲓϨⲓⲏⲃ ⲉⲧⲭⲏ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉⲙ̀ⲑⲟ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲑ̀ⲣⲟⲛⲟⲥ Ⲛ̀ⲑⲟϥ ⲉϥⲙⲟϣⲓ ⲛⲉⲙⲱⲟⲩ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲉϥⲉ̀ϭⲓⲙⲱⲓⲧ ⲛⲱⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ϫⲉⲛ ϯⲙⲟⲩⲙⲓ ⲙ̀ⲙⲱⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ⲱⲛϧ:
text.cop_lat: 7:17 Je pihieeb etkee empe-emtho empi-ethronos Enthof efmoshi nemoou o-woh efechimoit noou ejen timoumi emmoou enonkh:
text.en: 7:17 for the Lamb who is in the midst of the throne will shepherd them and lead them to living fountains of waters.
text.ar: 17 لأَنَّ الْحَمَلَ الَّذِي فِي وَسَطِ الْعَرْشِ يَرْعَاهُمْ، وَيَقْتَادُهُمْ إِلَى يَنَابِيعِ مَاءٍ حَيَّةٍ،

text.cop: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲉ̀ⲣⲉ Ⲫ̀ϯ ϥⲱϯ ⲛ̀ⲉⲣⲙⲏ ⲛⲓⲃⲉⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϩⲁ ⲛⲟⲩⲃⲁⲗ.
text.cop_lat: o-woh ere Efnoti foti enermee niven evol ha nouval.
text.en: And God will wipe away every tear from their eyes."
text.ar: وَيَمْسَحُ اللهُ كُلَّ دَمْعَةٍ مِنْ عُيُونِهِمْ».

text.cop: Ⲁ̀ⲛⲟⲕ ⲁⲓⲛⲁⲩ ⲉ̀ⲡ̀ⲕⲱⲧ ⲛ̀ⲟⲩⲡⲟⲗⲓⲥ ⲉⲥⲱϣϫ ⲛ̀ⲛⲟⲩⲃ ϩⲓ ⲱ̀ⲛⲓ ⲙ̀ⲙⲏⲓ ⲡⲓⲙⲁⲣⲅⲁⲣⲓⲧⲏⲥ ⲉⲑⲛⲉⲥⲱⲥ.
text.cop_lat: Anok ainav e-epkot enoupolis esoshg ennoub hi oni emmee pimargharitees ethnesos.
text.en: I looked at the city building armored gold, and the precious stones, and the good pearls.
text.ar: أنا نظرت إلي بناء المدينة المصفحة بالذهب، والحجارة الكريمة، والجواهر الحسنة.

section.en: Response for the Stones - Ch 21, Ⲁ̀ⲛⲟⲕ ⲁⲓⲛⲁⲩ
section.path: Fasts › Holy Pascha Week › Bright Saturday › The Book of the Revelation of St. John the Beloved

text.en: The first foundation was Jasper.
The second was sapphire.
The third was a chalcedony.

text.cop: Ⲉ̀ⲣⲉ ⲡⲉⲛⲤⲱⲧⲏⲣ ϧⲉⲛ ⲧⲉⲥⲙⲏϯ ⲉϥϯⲭ̀ⲗⲟⲙ ϩⲓ ⲧⲁⲓⲟ̀ ⲛ̀ⲛⲏⲉⲑⲙⲉⲓ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟϥ.
text.cop_lat: Ere pensoteer khen tesmeeti efti-eklom hi tai-o ennee-ethmei emmof.
text.en: And our Savior in the midst of it giving a crown and honoring the ones who love Him.
text.ar: مخلصنا في وسطها يعطي إكليلاً وكرامة للذين يحبونه.

text.en: The fourth was an emerald.
The fifth was sardonyx.
The sixth was sardius.

text.en: and the Holy Spirit,
Hail to the Church,
the house of the angels.
+ Hail to the Virgin,
who gave birth to our Savior,
Hail to Gabriel who announced,
to her the Good News.
Hail to Michael,
the archangel,
Hail to the twenty four,
Presbyters.
+ Hail to the Cherubim,
Hail to the Seraphim,
Hail to all the hosts,
of the heavens.
Hail to John,
the great forerunner,
Hail to the,
twelve apostles.
+ Hail to our father Mark,
the Evangelist,
the destroyer,
of the idols.
Hail to Stephen,
the first martyr,
Hail to George,
the morning star.
+ Hail to the whole choir,
of the martyrs,
Hail to Abba Antony,
and the three Macarii.
Hail to the whole choir,
of the cross-bearers,
Hail to all the saints,
who have pleased the Lord.
+ Through their prayers,
O Christ our King,
have mercy upon us,
in Your kingdom.
O my Lord Jesus Christ,
Who was Placed in the tomb,
trample down for us the sting
of Death.
+ Hail to the Cross,
which my Lord was crucified upon,
Hail to the grave,
where they placed His body
The Cross is our weapon,
the Cross is our hope,
the Cross is our confirmation,
in our troubles and sufferings.
+ O King of peace,
grant us Your peace,
render unto us Your peace,
and forgive us our sins.
Disperse the enemies,
of the Church,
and fortify her,
that she may not be shaken forever.
+ Emmanuel our God,
is now in our midst,
with the glory
of His Father,
May He bless us all,
and purify our hearts,
and heal the sicknesses,
of our souls and bodies.
+ We worship You O Christ,
with Your Good Father,
and the Holy Spirit,
for You were crucified and saved us.
O my Lord Jesus Christ,

text.en: Who was Placed in the tomb,
